name: PocketCurator
summary: Manages a user's own ROM collection from an EmulationStation-style interface.

notes: Review on 2026-10-20 verified the stable v1.1.2 ZIP against the publisher sidecar and GitHub digest: 5903925 compressed bytes, 19915921 regular-file bytes, 211 files and 21 directories. No duplicate paths, traversal, absolute paths, or special-file entries were found. Release mutability alone is not the remaining blocker when exact bytes are pinned.

Blocked by runtime policy: user-selected ROM, media, and gamelist writes lack reviewed /userdata containment and symlink-parent checks. A disposable-fixture probe of the packaged delete_paths function confirmed it deletes a supplied regular file outside the fixture userdata directory. This is a write-boundary test, not proof that every UI path can supply that file.

The packaged updater and netsync download executable code outside Store transactions. PC_SKIP_UPDATE only skips launcher application of staged updates; it does not disable these downloads. The launcher can also acquire and mount a PortMaster runtime.

A reviewed package must disable executable-code downloads and runtime acquisition, constrain every write path, and resolve the ROM-fetch provider policy before promotion. Missing exact device evidence will show UNTESTED, not block installation once these package controls pass.

evidence.note: Downloaded stable ZIP SHA-256 bb1907289bb5e22c6d24c39b9fae6dac0c17b75821a6565d77fcba3cce9af664 matches the publisher sidecar and GitHub API digest. ZIP CRC and entry inspection passed. Only the inspected deletion module was exercised with disposable files; no launcher or installer was executed.

Packaged netsync.py downloads .sh/.zip/.py over HTTP into the parent Ports directory after a developer-network DNS gate. Packaged updater.py conditionally checks a publisher checksum; neither path uses Store transactions.
MIT project license and bundled dependency notices reviewed.
Upstream lists TrimUI Smart Pro, but does not tie that claim to Knulli, v1.1.2, or a lifecycle result.
